meta.name: NX Trading — v2: AI-core re-architecture + cross-asset expansion

stack.framework: Next.js 16.3.4 (App Router, Turbopack) — consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before framework-level changes
stack.css: Tailwind CSS 4 via @tailwindcss/postcss (CSS vars + @theme inline; NO tailwind.config)

conventions.pageAnatomy: lib/<feature>.ts (types, seed, pure tick, stats) -> components/<feature>.tsx (stateless presentational) -> app/<route>/layout.tsx (server: metadata + default pass-through) -> app/<route>/page.tsx (client orchestrator)
conventions.hydration: gate first paint with useMounted() from components/framework.tsx; render <Splash /> until mounted
conventions.determinism: all randomness via seeded rng (mulberry32 variant); pure tick functions accept state and return next state — never Math.random() outside an rng
conventions.lint: npx next lint does NOT exist — use npx eslint .
conventions.types: tsc needs .next/types present; order is next build -> tsc -> eslint
conventions.subshell: use npx next start / npx next build (next not on PATH)

validationGate: npx next build (new routes listed, static)
npx next start -p <free-port> + curl new routes -> HTTP 200
flip subtask/story/epic status in this file; EpicStatus + meta.updated per epic

currentStrengths: clean lib->components->app decomposition across all 13 routes
deterministic seeded data + hydration-safe live ticking
consistent dark design system + UI kit
full static build, zero lint/type issues
aiCentricGaps: lib/agent.ts streams pre-written prose (pick of static strings) — the 'AI' narrates nothing it computes
signals attach a random engine label + canned reason — no score computed from live data
no model identity: no versions, no drift, no champion/challenger, no per-model P&L
no explainability: reasons are copy, not feature attributions
no governance: kill-switch, confidence bands, and override audit are decorative at best
performance attribution is strategy/symbol/factor — never the model
realismGaps: one fake clock, no market sessions, no holidays, no RTH/half-day, no FX 24h / futures 23h reality
every ticker is an independent random walk — no correlation structure or shared regime state
no macro events: FOMC/CPI/NFP exist only as flavor strings in agent prose
orders always fill instantly at mid, no spread/slippage/latency/queue, never rejected
no money model: margin, buying power, interest, per-venue/per-instrument fees, reconciliation all missing
instruments are only spot crypto + 4 equities — no options, futures, treasuries, FX, international
venue set is 3 crypto venues + implicit Alpaca — no equity/futures broker (Interactive Brokers), no capability matrix
no strategy lifecycle: no paper->live gate, no sizing/stop/risk params tied to go-live, no walk-forward
opportunityGaps: options module: chains, greeks, IV skew, strategy templates (vertical/straddle/iron condor), max pain + GEX
futures: contract ladders, open interest, rolls, tick value, margin per contract
treasuries: yield curve, duration/DV01, 2s10s spread, duration ladder
FX majors: DXY, carry, 24h sessions vs equity RTH contrast
international: ADR vs local split, local-session badges, emerging ETFs
Interactive Brokers as unified broker: netting, buying power, rate, FLEX-style reconciliation, cross-asset capability matrix vs crypto venues
OMS realism: BRK/OCO/iceberg, amendment/cancel/reject with reasons, queue position, partial fills, execution reports
AI brain: model registry, champion/challenger A/B, drift, promote/pause, explain panel, per-signal feature attribution, model-attributed P&L
review.strategy: Turn AI from narration into a score that is computed from tick data (lib/brain.ts). Build a shared realistic market core (sessions, correlation, macro events, microstructure) that all asset classes tick against. Then bolt the instrument extensions on. End with OMS realism and the strategy lifecycle so AI decisions survive contact with friction.

meta.howToUpdate: flip subtask/story/epic status as work lands (todo -> in-progress -> done); set epicStatus when all stories done; bump meta.updated per epic; overallStatus = done when final validation gate passes across all routes (v1 + v2)

epics.title: Cross-asset market data core (universe, sessions, correlation, regime)
epics.summary: Replace lib/market.ts's independent random walks with a single correlated, regime-aware, session-aware market core that every instrument class ticks against. This is the foundation; nothing else in v2 looks 'realistic' without it.

stories.title: Instrument universe + taxonomy

subtasks.text: InstrumentType = 'spot'|'future'|'option'|'treasury'|'fx'|'etf'; InstrumentMeta { symbol, type, venue(s), tickSize, contracts?, expiry?, multiplier?, session }
seedUniverse(): keep v1 7 crypto+equity, add ES/NQ/ZB/ZN/ZF futures, TLH+SPX spot, 5 FX majors, ~10 international/ADR, ~12 optionable underlyings
per-instrument tick cadence + price path params (vol, drift) by type; futures quoted in ticks with tick value, treasuries in yield (not price)
acceptance: tsc clean; universe pure + deterministic given seed; no Math.random() outside rng

acceptance: strict tsc clean; seeded deterministic; pure tickers

stories.title: Shared regime + correlated random state

subtasks.text: regime = { volState: 'calm'|'chop'|'riskoff', trend: -1|0|+1, driver: string }; tick regime rarely, persist to state so UI can surface it
one shared shock = rng()*regime.vol; each instrument = shock*beta(type) + idiosyncratic; riskoff pushes equities/futures down, treasuries up, gold up, crypto most
expose correlation matrix (5x5 asset-class) as data for UI heat panels; riskoff makes es/btc/nvda move the same direction on a tick
acceptance: given regime + seed, two instruments' tick signs are correlated, not independent; tsc clean

acceptance: ticks are correlated by regime, not independent walks

stories.title: Sessions + market clock (global)

subtasks.text: Session = 'pre'|'open'|'lunch'|'close'|'futures'|'fx-24h'|'halted'; per-instrument session table (ES open ~ Sun-Fri 18:00-17:00 ET, equity RTH 09:30-16:00 ET, FX 24x5)
marketClock(now) returns per-class state + next-event countdown (equity open, FOMC, ...); feed ticks only for instruments in an active session — others show 'closed' badge not movement
half-day + a holiday (e.g. 15th month end) → equity session shortened, futures still open — visible contrast on the clock
acceptance: tsc clean; clock pure; closed instruments don't tick

acceptance: sessions gate ticks; clock pure + deterministic

stories.title: Macro event calendar (engine-level)

subtasks.text: Event { kind: FOMC|CPI|NFP|PCE|ECB|JPM, t, volMult, gapBias }; seed 2 weeks of events
eventPhase(now) -> 'pre'(vol up to volMult)|'live'|'post'(decays); tickers amplify shock*volMult in pre/live
at print: apply one gap (sign = gapBias + noise) across correlated set, then regime may flip — this is the signature realism beat
acceptance: pre-event ticks are visibly higher vol; print produces a discontinuity; post decays; tsc clean

acceptance: FOMC/CPI/NFP produce pre-vol + gap + decay; pure + deterministic

epics.title: AI Brain: computed scores, model registry, A/B, explain, kill-switch
epics.summary: Turn the AI from narration into computation. lib/brain.ts scores real tick data per model (each model is a named, versioned, pure function). Signals carry feature attributions, not copy. A model registry manages champion/challenger with drift + per-model P&L. The agent page narrates real computations. This is the centerpiece of 'more AI centric AND more realistic.'

stories.title: lib/brain.ts — signal as a computation

subtasks.text: Features(instrument, state) -> { momZ, bookImb, funding, ivSlope, regimeBeta, spreadBps, corrToEs, ... } — all derived from V1 tick data, no random
Model = { id, name, version, universe, weights?, score(features)->number in [-1,1] }; 6 models (momentum-v4.2, orderflow-imb, funding-capture, mean-revert-ml, vol-arb-v2, cross-venue-arb)
decision(model, features) -> { score, side, confidence, attributions: {featureName: contribution}[] } — attribution is score*weight normalized, sums to score
signals now: each has modelId + attributions + score; reason string is generated from top-2 attributions (so it never contradicts the data)
acceptance: given identical features, decision is identical; attribution sums to score within 1e-9; tsc clean

acceptance: signal = f(features); attribution exact; deterministic

stories.title: Model registry + champion/challenger + drift + P&L

subtasks.text: ModelRecord { id, name, version, universe, status: 'live'|'challenger'|'paused', sharpe, dd, winRate, drift: 0-1, pnlUsd, samples, since, championFor? }
drift(model, recent, baseline) = |mean(features_recent)-mean(features_baseline)| normalized — a computed number, not a label
attributionPnl(models, fills): attribute realized P&L to the model that fired the entry (from signal.modelId)
promote/demote: championFor per universe; challenger becomes champion on win; drift>threshold auto-pauses (kill switch), surfaces in agent feed
acceptance: promote/demote pure; drift computed; P&L sums to total within rounding; tsc clean

acceptance: registry with A/B + drift + per-model P&L; pure + deterministic

epics.title: Strategy lifecycle: template → backtest → paper → live + gates
epics.summary: A strategy is not a label, it's a lifecycle: pick a template, parameterize, backtest (walk-forward + Monte Carlo + sensitivity), paper trade, then go live with explicit risk params (stop, sizing, daily loss cap). The AI Brain (V6) can propose params; the OMS (V8) enforces risk. This closes the loop from 'idea' to 'live' and makes the AI accountable.

stories.title: Strategy object + lifecycle state

subtasks.text: Strategy { id, modelId, universe, params, risk: { stopPct, sizeUsd, dailyLossCap, maxCorr }, state: 'template'|'backtested'|'paper'|'live'|'killed', since }
gates: goLive(strat) requires backtested.winRate>0.5 && sharpe>1 && dd<10 || AI signoff (from V6 decision); paper → live on min samples; kill on dd cap or drift>threshold (V6)
aiSuggestParams(universe, recent) -> a candidate param set with a one-line rationale from a V6 decision — 'momentum on NVDA z-score', not a random string
acceptance: goLive gates are computable; ai-suggest pure; strategy state machine never invalid; tsc clean

acceptance: strategy has state + risk + gates; pure + deterministic

sensitivityHeatmap(params): grid of 2 params -> Sharpe; highlight the flat region (robust) vs the spike (overfit)
